notes: The p+N15 driver energy is deposited instantaneously and uniformly before the pressure-drive integration.
The tamper is a coherent thin inertial piston; its physical outer radius is calculated using the stated reference density.
At trigger compression, the selected fraction of inward kinetic energy is shock-thermalized in the core.
D-T is burned inside the compressed core as a late match, not added to the external p+N15 driver mass.
After the trigger, continued external-driver pressure and its residual internal energy are discarded, making the post-trigger handoff conservative relative to the pressure stage.
The D-T neutron core-deposition fraction is an optimistic placement assumption derived from the old whole-assembly stopping result and is swept separately in interpretation.
